title: Installation Credit Recapture When a Comfort Club Agreement Is Cancelled
content:
A member who received the Comfort Club member installation credit on a Harbison replacement installation and then cancels the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement has part of that credit recaptured. The rule reads the member installation credits posted on the member's installation contracts under Replacement System Installations.

## Install credit recapture rule
- The **install credit recapture** is the member installation credit posted on the member's Harbison installation contracts within the 12 months before the date of handling, multiplied by the install credit recapture rate and rounded to the cent half up.
- The rate is set by when the member's most recent member installation credit was posted:

| Most recent member installation credit posted | Install credit recapture rate |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the date of handling | 0.5 (the recent-credit rate) |
| 6 or more but fewer than 12 whole calendar months before | 0.25 (the within-a-year rate) |
| None posted within the 12 months before the date of handling | no recapture under this rule |

## Examples (hypothetical member installation credit of 400.00)
- Posted 4 whole months before the date of handling: 400.00 multiplied by 0.5 recaptures 200.00.
- Posted 8 whole months before: 400.00 multiplied by 0.25 recaptures 100.00.
- Posted 14 whole months before: nothing recaptured.

## Boundary points
- Exactly 6 whole months: the within-a-year rate of 0.25 applies, not 0.5.
- Exactly 12 whole months: outside both bands.
